title: A common strictly standard exponent for finitely many smooth free opens
statement: Let R→C be a finitely presented map of commutative rings [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra], let ι be a finite type and x:ι→C. Assume each C_(x_i) is smooth over R [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map], with free module Ω_(C_(x_i)/R) of Kähler differentials [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials]. There is c≥1 such that every x_i^c is strictly standard over R [def-weil-pbc-strictly-standard-element].

source.place: Lemma 07EZ(e) and proof of Lemma 07FE, common exponent

proof.text: For each index install the given smoothness and freeness instances. KaehlerDifferential.finite gives finite generation (the smooth localization is essentially of finite type). Reindex Module.Free.chooseBasis along Fintype.equivFin; its representation identifies the differentials with a finite coordinate module, also over the zero ring. Compose with LinearEquiv.prodUnique to add the zero free summand. Apply smooth_free_differentials_strictly_standard_power with s=0 and t the cardinality of this basis index to obtain a positive threshold valid for all larger exponents.

Choose all thresholds e_i from the preceding existential statements. Take c=1+Σ_i e_i. Finset.single_le_sum and Nat.le_add_left give e_i≤c for each i. Apply its threshold theorem at c. Nat.le_add_right gives 1≤c, and the same construction gives c=1 for an empty family.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 07EZ(a),(e); common exponent in Lemma 07FE, using a finite basis and the sum of thresholds
